articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Nǐ dào nǎli qù?
MR. ANDERSON: Where are you going?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Wǒ dào kāfēitīng qù. Nǐ zhīdao bu zhīdao Huáměi Kāfēitīng?
COMRADE WÁNG: I'm going to a coffeehouse. Do you know of the Huáměi Coffeehouse?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Bù zhīdào. Dào nǎli qù, zěnme zǒu?
MR. ANDERSON: No, I don't. How do I get there?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Cóng zhèli wàng zuǒ zǒu. Dàole lùkǒu, zài wàng yòu zǒu, jiù dào le.
COMRADE WÁNG: From here you go to the left. When you reach the intersection, go right, and then you're there.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ xiān wàng zuǒ zǒu, duì bu duì?
MR. ANDERSON: First I go to the left. Is that correct?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Ránhòu, dàole lùkǒu, zài wàng yòu zǒu.
COMRADE WÁNG: After that, when you reach the intersection, then you go to the right.
